ai_summary: Adani Green Energy Limited (ADANIGREEN) has informed exchanges about planned investor and analyst interactions in late November 2026, including participation in the Citi 2026 India Investor Tour and domestic equity non-deal roadshows. While these are routine investor relations activities requiring regulatory disclosure, announcing specific meeting dates nearly three years in advance is highly unusual.
